summary: Vox Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K with unaudited interim financial statements, MD&A, certifications, and a press release for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results, including royalty revenue, net precious metals income, and a notable gain on disposition of royalty interests. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review, is announced in the excerpt. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer, with no event triggering special-situations classification.
